messages.author: 5366fd82ceb56732
messages.subject: Distance 6.0 R2 in Windows 7
parts:
Hi Len, List

I am unable to install Distance 6.0 R2 using Windows 7 Ultimate (with Serv. pack 1; 32-bit operating system) on a Sony Vaio laptop.
I get an error message "MSVCP60.dll could not be opened. Please check that your disk is not full& that you have access to the destination directory"
I have 100 GB of space on the drive, and the permissions on the system32 folders says I
have "read& execute" permission. I have tried installing as an administrator, checking for viruses/malware, running Sfc /scannow
at the command prompt. All other of my usual programs (including Presence,MARK) so far I can install. Any suggestions would
be greatly appreciated.


George Gale

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: Distance 6.0 R2 in Windows 7
parts:
Hi George,

This is not something I've come across before. Can you please log it on our bug
tracking site (go to the Distance home page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/
and click on "Report a bug in Distance"), and we can continue the conversation
there about possible fixes -- that way they are recorded for others looking for
the same thing (but is off the list where most aren't interested).

Ultimately, I may need to change the installer I use for the Distance software,
as the one we use is way out of date. More immediately, you could perhaps try
installing the Microsoft Visual C version 6 redistributable
http://support.microsoft.com/kb/259403
or, at worst, install in Windows 7 XP model (which basically puts an XP virtual
machine onto your computer - it's free with some versions of Windows). Anyway,
let's carry on off the list.

Cheers - Len
